title: dryopteris inaequalis
intro: Dryopteris inaequalis, commonly known as the Unequal Lady Fern, is a species of fern native to Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Unequal Lady Fern is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antifungal properties.
